reference_audit.method: Every canonical task/acceptance evidence and coverage report reference read as exact committed Git blobs; content digests plus JSON parsing, empty-file and local Markdown target checks. Primary narratives and pending records reviewed semantically, not inferred passed from file existence.

placeholder_semantic_review.disposition: All TODO token matches are literal historical task-count/status values or the reentry controller counting todo tasks. The sole placeholder token identifies intentionally sanitized command-path aliases with raw capture hashes kept separately. None is an implementation TODO falsely reported complete.

pending_records.disposition: No cleared clips admitted; listening/consent/reviewer fields remain pending.
Exact base settings registered; formal speech comparison and approval are explicitly not performed.
Pending attributable speech review is an honest human-gate integrity record, not a passed audition.
Real screenshots/audio registries are empty/pending and require consent; MIT branding only.
Draft source/date/download fields are null, stable download disabled; not an actual published release.

retained_gaps.required_for: Mandatory before any speech-quality/default-sound promotion claim; exact settings/revision/owner approval remain required.
retained_gaps.reason: Formal level-matched Original/Gentle/custom speech corpus review and attributable per-clip results are absent. AC-064 user playback accepts its original workflow only.

retained_gaps.required_for: Mandatory before claiming universal manual Explorer drop, punctuation or multi-file gesture coverage.
retained_gaps.reason: Actual CMD transport/synthetic matrices are engineering checks. Only AC-064's two neutral-name manual retries are observed; its initial unquoted parentheses input was rejected. Earlier percent/exclamation expansion cannot be reconstructed by the BAT.

retained_gaps.required_for: Mandatory before accepting actual file-dialog and Explorer follow-up gestures on the active host.
retained_gaps.reason: Picker/open helpers have controlled engineering coverage; no manual dialog cancellation/selection or follow-up Explorer action was performed.

retained_gaps.required_for: Extended gate required before claiming >4 GB/full-volume/long-recording durability or memory/storage stress support.
retained_gaps.reason: Small RF64 headers, bounded size estimates, simulated low space/save faults and short synthetic jobs do not cover full >4 GB exports, actual volume exhaustion, long-running capture or broad UNC/long-path/storage stress.

retained_gaps.required_for: Mandatory before any graceful console-close/logoff/forced-host-kill or power-loss recovery claim. No multi-file atomicity/durability guarantee is accepted.
retained_gaps.reason: Controlled encoder/report/save failures and native Ctrl+C/Break signals cannot establish actual host termination, console-window close or power-loss cleanup. Owned crash leftovers may remain.

retained_gaps.required_for: Mandatory before claiming the skipped file-symlink fixture passed; preserve the actual privilege skip separately from junction/hardlink coverage.
retained_gaps.reason: The recorded host cannot create a file symlink without unavailable privilege. Other identity/reparse tests do not turn that skip into a pass.

retained_gaps.required_for: Mandatory before broadening independent meter accuracy, positive-LUFS parsing, arbitrary codec seek or cross-build reproduction claims.
retained_gaps.reason: Same-build synthetic mechanics use FFmpeg meters and declared timestamp tolerances. Positive integrated loudness remains rejected, container seeking has recorded sample uncertainty, and five-second preview context can differ from a full render.

retained_gaps.required_for: Mandatory before claiming recovery from a real OS or uncooperative stream refusing writer-handle release.
retained_gaps.reason: Preview writer-close fault doubles dispose the real inner stream before throwing. They prove later close attempts and truthful retained outcomes but do not prove recovery when an actual OS writer stays held or Dispose refuses to release it.

ac_085_assessment.reason: All 20 planned improvement implementations have accepted engineering evidence; M5-04 is a future explicit-action approval task, not deferred engineering implementation. Existing AC-009/042/047/081 and RELEASE_WEBSITE explicitly accept honest unavailable listening/media records and a portable draft. No owner deferral approval is fabricated.
conditions: Final traceability must explicitly preserve all eight broader coverage gaps and their risks; none is called executed or waived.
AC-085..087 remain unrun at this audit baseline; root records actual final audit/safety/delivery outcomes before changing their statuses.
M5-04 and AC-088..090 stay unrun until an exact approved consequential action; no merge, tag, release, deployment or bundled FFmpeg is implied.
Original remains default and Gentle opt-in experimental; formal speech quality/default promotion is not accepted.
Pending screenshots/audio/consent and null draft publication fields remain honest and download-disabled.
Any genuinely unmet implementation uncovered later must block or receive explicit owner-approved deferral; claim limits must not be used to hide a missing required implementation.

No missing/nonempty/invalid-JSON/internal-link or implementation-placeholder issue was found across 291 exact committed report references. This records evidence integrity, not a new execution of all historical tests.

known_historical_records.disposition: Initial blocked Smart App Control checkpoint explicitly superseded by successful WAC-M1-02-resume.md; both histories retained.
Final owner-observed Raw/Zoom retries accepted; initial unquoted parentheses drop failed and broad gesture coverage remains limited.
Historical website-metadata-absent sentence describes its earlier source; M5-01 later implements the static draft, rather than retroactively changing old evidence.
